name: Kilimanjaro by the Lemosho route
why: The long western way: two days of forest, a walk across the whole Shira plateau, Lava Tower and the Barranco Wall, with the most time to get used to the height.
book: Kilimanjaro National Park fees per day, paid through a licensed operator: climbing without a registered guide and porters is not allowed. Most climbs start from Moshi. Transfer to Londorossi Gate takes 3-4 hours from Moshi.
water: Porters boil stream water at every camp.
dangers: Altitude: the summit is at 5,895 m. Headache, vomiting, confusion or breathlessness at rest: go down at once.
Summit night starts around midnight, -10 to -20 C with wind at the crater rim.
Afternoon storms and hail in the rainy months (March to May, November).
turnaround: Be at Stella Point by 07:00 on summit night, or turn back.

points.name: Lemosho Gate
points.note: A remote trailhead in the western forest, where colobus monkeys live.

points.name: Shira 2 Camp
points.note: On the Shira plateau, a wide high plain of heather at 3,800 m, the collapsed crater of the oldest volcano.

points.name: Lava Tower
points.note: A 90 m volcanic plug at 4,630 m: you climb high and sleep low.

points.name: Barranco Wall
points.note: A 250 m rock wall you scramble up with hands, above Barranco Camp.

points.name: Uhuru Peak
points.note: The 5,895 m summit and its glaciers.

points.name: Mweka Gate
points.note: The way down through the forest.
